description: Land a self-driven, self-healing Orleans cluster-singleton event dispatcher that pulls undelivered event rows from all four truth tables each tick, fans them out by type to matching [Subscription] handlers with per-handler retry, dead-letters poison messages, and marks each row delivered — reactivating the dormant cross-aggregate reactions. Re-creates the DeadLetters persistence layer as a prerequisite.

tasks.title: Re-create the DeadLetters persistence layer
tasks.description: Re-introduce the DeadLetters persistence layer deleted in ba50c2089. Add a DeadLetterRow entity with event snapshot, failing-handler diagnostics, and explicit Pending/Redelivering/Resolved recovery state. Add handler-keyed uniqueness and an atomic settlement operation that upserts exhausted handlers while marking the source event in one transaction. Back query/get/recovery operations with DeadLetterStore plus test fakes and EF migrations.
acceptanceCriteria: DeadLetterRow entity exists and DeadLetters DbSet is registered in MohistDbContext with PK DeadLetterId and indexes HasIndex(DeadLetteredAt) and HasIndex(FailingHandler, DeadLetteredAt).
EF migrations create the table, recovery-state columns, and unique (Source, Id, FailingHandler) index; they apply cleanly against MigratedSqliteTemplate and MohistDbContextModelSnapshot has no drift.

IDeadLetterStore exposes direct write/query/get operations plus SettleAsync, StartRedeliveryAsync, RecordRedeliveryFailureAsync, ResolveAsync, and DeleteAsync; test fakes implement the same state semantics.
SettleAsync commits dead-letter upserts and source DispatchedAt atomically; a source-mark failure commits neither side, and retrying the same event/handler retains one row.
Recovery persists Redelivering before handler invocation, returns failures to Pending, marks success Resolved, and excludes resolved rows from unresolved queries.
Store and migration specs cover write/query/get/delete, atomic rollback, uniqueness, and recovery-state transitions; the server test suite is green and TreatWarningsAsErrors stays clean.
tasks.output: Infrastructure/Data/Events/DeadLetterRow.cs, Infrastructure/Events/IDeadLetterStore.cs, Infrastructure/Data/Events/DeadLetterStore.cs, test fakes, MohistDbContext DeadLetters registration, creation + hardening EF migrations, and store tests.
tasks.notes: The historical row shape is extended with recovery state. The first migration creates DeadLetters; the hardening migration adds status/timestamps and unique (Source, Id, FailingHandler). DispatchedAt already exists on all four source truth tables.

tasks.title: Implement the self-driven cluster-singleton event dispatcher
tasks.description: Build the sole, self-healing notifier as an Orleans cluster-singleton grain over a pure-DI fan-out service. Pull all truth tables, deliver matching subscriptions with per-handler retry, atomically settle poison outcomes, and preserve serial FIFO. Persist AgentJob trigger inputs and stable runner work identities before acknowledgement so activation loss resumes one job/work. Keep documented best-effort handlers best-effort, scope closed-generic Epic queries per delivery, and expose loopback-only, operator-credential-protected, redacted API/CLI recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: IDispatcherGrain (IGrainWithStringKey, IRemindable) and DispatcherGrain exist with fixed key "dispatcher"; every other key is rejected before reminder registration or dispatch; the fixed-key grain registers a persisted reminder (~1s, cadence configurable) on activation, and both ReceiveReminder and PulseAsync run exactly one pull–fan-out–mark cycle by delegating to EventDispatcherService.DispatchAsync.

DispatcherActivationService activates the fixed-key grain during host startup, and an integration spec verifies that a fresh host delivers an appended event on its first hosted-service-registered reminder without direct activation, callback invocation, or producer Pulse.

EventDispatcherService is a plain DI singleton taking IEventStore, IEnumerable<Subscription>, IDeadLetterStore, TimeProvider, ILogger; every DispatchedAt/DeadLetteredAt timestamp is sourced from the injected TimeProvider (no DateTimeOffset.UtcNow in the dispatch path).

Each tick calls IEventStore.ListUndeliveredAsync (the single UNION over WorkflowRun/Issue/Epic/AgentSession truth tables), processes the batch serially in (Source, Id) order, and applies CloudEventTypeMatcher.Matches(subscription.Type, event.Type) to decide fan-out per subscription.
Per-handler retry uses a fixed attempt cap; exhausted handler rows and the original event DispatchedAt are committed through one atomic dead-letter settlement.
Per-handler isolation holds: when an event matches two handlers and one exhausts, the sibling handler still receives the event independently and its outcome does not depend on the failing handler.
Per-row DispatchedAt is set only after all matching handlers have settled (succeeded or dead-lettered); no undelivered row is marked before delivery.
Settlement uses the EventOrigin returned by ListUndeliveredAsync to select the persisted truth table; custom/future source URIs routed through the WorkflowRun fallback remain markable after delivery.
A MarkDispatchedAsync failure propagates and stops the current batch so a higher row in the same stream cannot overtake the unmarked row.

The closed-generic discovery bug in AddCloudEventHandlersFromAssembly is fixed (proper ICloudEventHandler<> closed-generic scan) so EpicAutoDoneHandler and EpicCancelledReconcileHandler are registered and invoked in the fan-out; malformed subscription patterns fail registration before delivery can begin.
InMemoryEventBus no longer reads DateTimeOffset.UtcNow; it uses an injected TimeProvider for the envelope timestamp.

RedeliverAsync(deadLetterId) retries only the recorded failing handler, persists success and failure recovery transitions in the production store, marks success resolved, and remains available through loopback-only server API and mo CLI surfaces that reject non-loopback targets before credential resolution, support explicit managed secret-path symlinks while protecting the generated default file, redact POSIX/drive-letter/UNC diagnostics, expose recovery status, and render terminal-safe table output.

Required durable handler side effects are awaited and propagate failure; Inbox projection plus its InboxItemPersisted durable hint commit in one transaction, while documented best-effort Hermes notifications and Agent subscription launches remain log-and-swallow and never enter retry/dead-letter flow.

Agent subscription launches persist trigger correlation in the initial session open and use stable session/job identities; AgentJob input (including raw AgentConfig JSON), candidate runner, work id, explicit Runner-accepted checkpoint, retry state, and terminal state are durable; prepared candidates reconcile acceptance by replaying the same work and release only after a proven rejection; missing poll responses reoffer accepted work until the runner reports it; the last Runner registration profile survives activation loss so the first poll restores presence without a separate heartbeat; unregister waits for an admitted poll before clearing that profile; poll admission captures capacity while holding one reconciliation gate through claims; slot updates wait for that gate; Agent work is counted before workflow claims; and RunnerGrain atomically rejects offline or over-capacity admission.
Closed-generic Epic handlers resolve scoped EpicQuerier instances inside an async scope per delivery; production scope validation succeeds.

EventDispatcherService, IDeadLetterStore→DeadLetterStore (with NoopDeadLetterStore via TryAdd), subscriptions, and AgentJob observer defaults are registered once in the host-shared application service graph; MohistSiloRegistration adds only Orleans infrastructure.

Unit tests (fake IEventStore + fake/Noop IDeadLetterStore + FakeTimeProvider) cover: pull→match→invoke→mark; directly observed per-stream FIFO (Source,Id) ordering with no skip; per-handler retry-then-succeed; exhaustion → dead-letter written + DispatchedAt set + not retried next tick; atomic fake rollback after a post-mark settlement failure; per-handler isolation; deliver-before-mark crash → row stays undelivered → re-delivered on next tick; CloudEventTypeMatcher fan-out including a closed-generic handler; invalid subscription registration.

Spec/integration tests cover hosted-service first-reminder delivery without Pulse using fake time and deterministic signals, rejection of non-fixed dispatcher keys, fixed-key recovery on another silo after host-silo loss, Pulse latency, closed-generic Epic delivery, Agent best-effort settlement, authenticated proxy rejection, CLI non-loopback credential isolation, UNC redaction, managed secret symlinks, production redelivery-failure persistence, all four event-table UNION branches and ordering, actual workflow stage handler delivery through EventDispatcherService, lost Agent poll-response redelivery, Runner activation-loss recovery without heartbeat, unregister/poll serialization, overlapping poll exclusion, poll/update capacity linearization, mixed Agent/workflow one-slot capacity, concurrent/offline Runner admission, real-EventStore atomic Inbox hint rollback/replay, and AgentJob prepared/accepted crash checkpoints with non-null AgentConfig and stable replacement work.
Server npm test is green and TreatWarningsAsErrors stays clean.
tasks.output: IDispatcherGrain.cs, DispatcherGrain.cs, DispatcherActivationService.cs, EventDispatcherService.cs, handler outcome/idempotency hardening, Agent poll reconciliation and shared capacity, atomic Inbox projection/hint persistence, the discovery/filter fix in CloudEventBusServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, the InMemoryEventBus TimeProvider edit, silo/host registrations, DeadLetterRoutes + mo event dead-letter commands/docs, and unit + spec/integration/CLI tests.
tasks.notes: Follow design.md decisions D1–D14. Retry is hand-rolled with a fixed attempt cap and no backoff/jitter. Fresh host startup calls EnsureStartedAsync and only the fixed dispatcher key may register a reminder. Durable handler failures propagate; documented best-effort handlers absorb their own failures. Poison settlement and Inbox projection/hint persistence are atomic. Agent launch replay resumes durable stable job/work identities, checkpoints Runner acceptance, replaces only proven-unaccepted candidates, and serializes unregister with admitted polls. Dead-letter recovery targets one handler and is available only through an operator-credential-protected loopback API + mo CLI connection that refuses non-loopback targets before reading the credential.
